verdict.rationale: Wise documents that businesses get global account details to receive payments, which implies they can view their account and routing information. Nothing in the evidence documents generating a bank verification letter, and balance statements are a different feature. Missing for 10: any documented bank verification letter generation, explicit documentation of viewing account and routing numbers anytime in the dashboard or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can view account and routing numbers and generate a bank verification letter anytime

citations.quote: Get paid easily in other currencies with global account details.
